title: 第五章 既然她也不是真的想离婚
content_zh:
傍晚，霍廷深的特助冯天过来了，还带来了两个保镖，笑眯眯地道：“夫人，杜小姐正在医院里养伤，霍总请您过去看看。”

    宣云溪：？

    不是说明天回老宅对杜若依道歉吗？虽然她明天也不会过去，但霍廷深怎么现在就找人来绑她了？

    “我不去！”

    宣云溪后退大一步，心里把霍廷深祖宗十八代都骂了个遍。

    “您是不舒服吗？那我让保镖扶着您走吧。”

    冯天使了个眼色，那两个人高马大的保镖朝她走了过来，宣云溪惊呆了，“你们真敢绑架我啊？”

    “这怎么会是绑架，我们只是帮您过去而已。”

    这个冯天一副道貌岸然的样子，宣云溪死死地瞪了他一眼，这个狗腿子！

    她万般不想过去，可胳膊拧不过大腿，想了想还是识时务者为俊杰比较好。只是出门的时候实在没忍住，她给霍廷深发了个竖中指的表情包过去。

    【？】

    【什么意思？】

    宣云溪气笑了，什么意思，当然是干你大爷的意思！

    但她没回复，收起手机坐进车里，想到待会儿就要见到杜若依了，心里不太好受。

    杜若依是杜家养女，从小和霍廷深一起长大，对霍廷深的喜欢只要不是瞎子都能看得出来。

    偏偏霍廷深看不出来，嘴硬他俩只是兄妹，对杜若依那些超出兄妹关系的行为无底线纵容。

    霍廷深这人实在优秀，外形家世都是顶级的不说，还拥有极高的智商，让颜控加智性恋的宣云溪为他长出了一颗恋爱脑，容忍了他和杜若依所有无边界行为，直到最后亲眼看到那两人睡在一起才忍不了。

    结果七年后，她还在和那两人纠缠，真的好气啊！

    “崽崽们，这几年我和杜若依总吵架吗？”她问。

    霍逸想了想说道：“妈妈不喜欢若依姑姑，看到爸爸和若依姑姑在一起就总生气。”

    霍灵补充了一句：“若依姑姑和太奶奶住在一起，以前我们每周回一次老宅看太奶奶，妈妈和若依姑姑就会吵起来。后来太奶奶不让妈妈回去了，就变成爸爸带我们回去。”
content_en:
In the evening, Huo Tingshen's special assistant Feng Tian came over and brought two bodyguards. He said with a smile: "Madam, Miss Du is recuperating in the hospital. Mr. Huo please come and take a look."

    Xuanyunxi:?

    Didn't he say that he would go back to his old house tomorrow and apologize to Du Roy? Although she won't go there tomorrow, why did Huo Tingshen find someone to tie her up now?

    "I'm not going!"

    Xuanyunxi took a big step back, scolding all the eighteen generations of Huo Tingshen's ancestors in his heart.

    "Are you feeling uncomfortable? Then I'll let the bodyguards help you walk."

    Feng Angel winked, and the two tall bodyguards walked towards her. Xuan Yunxi was stunned, "You really dare to kidnap me?"

    "How can this be a kidnapping? We are just helping you get there."

    This Feng Tian looked sanctimonious. Xuan Yunxi glared at him, this bitch!

    She didn't want to go there at all, but her arms couldn't twist her thighs. After thinking about it, it was better to be a wise man. But she couldn't hold it back when she went out, so she sent Huo Tingshen a middle finger emoticon.

    【? 】

    【What's the meaning? 】

    Xuanyunxi laughed angrily, "What do you mean? Of course I mean to fuck your uncle!"

    But she didn't reply. She put away her phone and got into the car. She felt uncomfortable thinking that she would see Du Ruoyi later.

    Du Ruoyi is the adopted daughter of the Du family. She grew up with Huo Tingshen. Anyone who is not blind can see her love for Huo Tingshen.

    But Huo Ting couldn't tell. He insisted that they were just brothers and sisters, and he had no bottom line in condoning Du Ruoyi's behavior that went beyond the relationship between brother and sister.

    Huo Tingshen is really an outstanding person. Not only his appearance and family background are top-notch, but he also has a very high IQ. Xuan Yunxi, who is both handsome and sapiosexual, grew a love brain for him and tolerated all the borderless behaviors of him and Du Ruoyi. He couldn't bear it until he finally saw the two sleeping together with his own eyes.

    As a result, seven years later, she was still struggling with those two people. She was really angry!

    "Hey guys, do Du Roy and I always quarrel in the past few years?" she asked.

    Huo Yi thought for a moment and said, "Mom doesn't like Aunt Ruoyi. She always gets angry when she sees dad and Aunt Ruoyi together."

    Huo Ling added: "Aunt Ruoyi and my great-grandmother lived together. We used to go back to the old house to see my great-aunt once a week, and my mother and Aunt Ruoyi would quarrel. Later, my great-aunt wouldn't let my mother go back, so it was my father who took us back."
title_en: Chapter 5 Since she doesn’t really want a divorce
